Business Analytics is part of the Data Engineering and Enterprise Platforms division, Office of the CIO. We turn data from systems across Braze into certified, decision-ready data products and business definitions. Our users are the teams that run the business: Sales, Marketing, Customer Experience, Partnerships, and their operations teams.
Our remit spans the business. We build on the foundations our sister data teams maintain, including ingestion, systems of record, and product telemetry, and own the models and definitions operators rely on day to day. We're also the main point of contact for many business teams that need something from the wider data organization.
WHAT YOU'LL DO
We're looking for a Senior Analytics Engineer who has worked closely with operations teams at a B2B SaaS company. You should be able to take a project from an ambiguous ask to a tested, documented data product with little supervision.
Most of your time will go to designing and building dbt models in Snowflake. The rest goes to the work around the models: pinning down definitions, writing requirements, and coordinating with sister data teams when a fix belongs in a model they own.
Braze is also starting to deliver more certified metrics through semantic models and AI agents in Snowflake. That work rests on the same fundamentals: precise definitions, clear grain, and an honest statement of what a model does and doesn't measure. Experience here will set you apart, but it isn't required.
Responsibilities:
• Design and build dbt models in Snowflake for sales pipeline, marketing lifecycle, partnerships, professional services, and customer success. Every significant build starts with a written design that gets reviewed. You'll also make light Looker changes when a model change requires them
• Model history so operators can see what was true at any point in time, using quarter-end snapshots, slowly changing attributes, and event time series
• Own metric definitions end to end. Get the teams involved to agree on one canonical definition, document it, and state plainly what each model measures and where it stops
• Fix problems wherever they live. When the issue sits in a model another team owns, trace the lineage, write the requirements, and get the fix made with that team
• Shape how the team builds. Help set and evolve our development, testing, and code review standards. Review pull requests, mentor teammates, and consolidate models that past projects left redundant
• Cut through ambiguity in both directions. Help stakeholders turn loose questions into precise asks. Help our data teams align on what a request means, which model it belongs in, and who should build it. Communicate clearly enough that everyone ends with the same understanding
WHO YOU ARE
• Experience: typically 6+ years in data roles, with deep hands-on analytics engineering or data modeling work and direct partnership with operations teams at a B2B SaaS company. We weigh depth of modeling experience over total years
• dbt and SQL in Snowflake: expert SQL and modular, DRY dbt development, including dimensional modeling, snapshots and incremental models, tests beyond uniqueness and not-null, and thorough documentation. You understand Snowflake performance and cost trade-offs
• Model and metric design: you design for grain, history, and reuse so the next project doesn't need a rewrite. You can walk us through shipped data products and the trade-offs behind their design
• Requirements from ambiguity: you turn loosely defined asks and undocumented processes into precise definitions and requirements
• Cross-team collaboration: you've worked through models and systems you didn't own and got changes made by building agreement across teams
• Technical leadership: you mentor others, review code carefully, and set standards teammates follow
• AI that makes your team better: you've shipped reusable workflows, skills, or tools that teammates adopted and that measurably improved how the team works. You use your experience to speed up the people around you as well as your own work
• Domain knowledge: GTM operations, post-sale, or business operations data in SaaS, such as CRM opportunities and accounts, marketing lifecycle, professional services, and customer success platforms
• Independent delivery: you scope, sequence, and communicate your own projects, including status and trade-offs
How you'll stand out:
• You've built semantic models or certified metric definitions used by AI or conversational analytics (for example Snowflake Cortex Analyst or the dbt Semantic Layer), including test question sets to evaluate answers
• You have working Python for ad-hoc analysis, diagnosing data quality issues, and analytical edge cases that go beyond SQL
• You've worked with data observability or data catalog tools

THE POSITION
Our roster has an opening with your name on it
FanDuel is looking for a Data Product Manager to join our centralized Data Products team and own the products and services behind how FanDuel personalizes and experiments. Your flagship product is Personalization, one of FanDuel’s largest strategic programs, and it is just getting started.
The vision has two parts. The first is one personalization service that works with any front end. Given a customer, a page, and a moment, it returns ranked content that any surface can render, across sports betting, casino, racing, predictions, fantasy, social and community, payments, editorial, and video. Redesign the app tomorrow and the service does not change. The second is a personalization flywheel. It is a closed loop where ideas are generated, pre-tested, run as live experiments, and analyzed, and each result feeds the next round. Today most good ideas never get tested because experiment capacity is scarce and analysis is slow. You will own the products that change that.
Working closely with the Director of Data Product, you will drive requirements, prioritization, and delivery across customer understanding, ranking, serving, and experimentation. You will partner daily with data science, ML Platform, ML engineering, product analytics, and product managers in every business unit to turn a fast-moving, cross-functional program into shipped, measurable results. This is a high-visibility role tied directly to our “One App, One Customer” data strategy, our 2027 OKRs, and customer engagement, retention, and revenue.
In addition to the specific responsibilities outlined above, employees may be required to perform other such duties as assigned by the Company. This ensures operational flexibility and allows the Company to meet evolving business needs.
THE GAME PLAN
Everyone on our team has a part to play
• Own the backlog and delivery for one personalization product area, such as experimentation tooling or ranking inputs, and deliver it in small, shippable releases.
• Work with the Director of Data Product and senior PMs to shape the personalization roadmap, recommending priorities and trade-offs based on customer data and experiment results.
• Translate broader program goals into clear problem statements, user stories, and acceptance criteria that engineering and data science can plan against.
• Partner with data science and ML engineering on recommendation and ranking approaches, asking questions about accuracy, latency, and cost, and turning their input into product requirements.
• Work with product analytics and the experimentation platform team to define hypotheses, success and guardrail metrics, and test readouts for your area, and share what you learn with the team.
• Support responsible gaming, privacy, and compliance requirements in your area by working with Legal, Compliance, and Responsible Gaming, and escalate open questions early.
• Give status updates to your pod and key stakeholders, flagging risks and blockers early so issues are resolved before they affect delivery.
• Escalate cross-team conflicts and decisions outside your remit to the Director, and bring a recommendation with each escalation.
• Seek and act on feedback from your manager, peers, and partners, and share knowledge with other PMs in the Product Management community.
• Contribute to other Data Product initiatives as priorities evolve, keeping focus on a small number of priorities rather than parallel work.
THE STATS
What we’re looking for in our next teammate
• 3+ years of experience as a Product Manager or Product Owner on personalization, recommendation, search, ranking, experimentation, or other data or ML-powered products, with a record of shipping and measuring results.
• Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field (Computer Science, Engineering, Statistics, Business, or related) or equivalent industry experience. A Master’s degree is a plus.
• Working knowledge of how recommender and ranking systems work (collaborative filtering, learning-to-rank, embeddings, or similar), enough to engage credibly with data scientists and ML engineers on accuracy, latency, and cost.
• Exposure to personalization across varied content types (commerce, media, gaming, social feeds, payments), including cold-start and cross-sell, is a strong plus.
• Hands-on experimentation experience. You have designed and run A/B tests, chosen primary and guardrail metrics, and read results carefully. You know common traps such as peeking, underpowered tests, and novelty effects.
• Hands-on use of AI tools in your product and experimentation work, such as using LLMs to draft hypotheses, design tests, or speed up analysis.
• Working understanding of how LLM-based agents are built and evaluated (tools, prompts, guardrails, and evals). Experience taking an agent into production is a plus.
• Product-led mindset: comfortable questioning engineering-led plans, using frameworks like DACI for decision clarity, and focusing on a small number of priorities.
• Clear communicator who writes crisp requirements, explains trade-offs to technical and non-technical audiences, and is comfortable sizing opportunities in dollar terms.
• SQL proficiency for exploring customer behavior, experiment results, and model performance data.
• Knowledge of sports, gaming, or entertainment, and/or experience in a heavily regulated industry with privacy and responsible-use constraints, is a plus. Familiarity with Databricks, Kafka, Amplitude, Snowplow, or Xtremepush is also a plus.
• Don’t check all the boxes? That’s okay! We encourage you to still apply if you feel like you possess an adjacent skill set and are interested in learning more about this position.

Sell what you love. For us and millions of users across the globe, that’s Spotify. Join the Sales team and you’ll build the relationships that help grow our business in existing markets and beyond. We don’t just sell creative solutions to our clients and partners, we help to shape them; using our expert knowledge of ad products, sales channels and the industry to impact the way the world experiences music and podcasts. 


The Sales Strategy & Operations team is a strategic partner to Sales leadership, turning business priorities into clear, actionable plans that accelerate growth across our Americas Ads business. As a Manager, Sales Strategy & Operations, you'll drive strategy and growth initiatives for our North America Enterprise business, with a primary focus on the U.S. This is an individual contributor role that reports to the Senior Manager, Sales Strategy - Americas Enterprise.

What You’ll Do
• Act as the day-to-day strategy partner to US Enterprise Directors and Heads of Sales, translating the regional plan set with the Senior Manager into account- and team-level actions.
• Build and maintain sales playbooks and custom sales motions by client health and maturity, giving sellers clear next steps for each stage (for example, one play for at-risk clients and another for those ready to grow).
• Execute revenue acceleration programs end to end, from building target account lists and seller materials to tracking results, for plays such as win-back, share-of-wallet expansion, multi-format adoption and SPIFFs.
• Conduct hands-on account, product and category analyses using first- and third-party data, such as competitive ad spend, to find why growth is lagging and recommend next steps.
• Prepare the analysis and materials behind weekly business reviews, seller performance metrics and leadership updates to drive accountability and flag risks and opportunities early.
• Support annual and quarterly coverage planning by building account segmentation, named account list and book models, and managing account moves.
• Build and use AI tools, including LLM tools, to automate recurring analysis and reporting and help sellers self-serve insights.
• Collaborate with Finance, Customer Success, Business Operations and Sales Comp to get programs live and keep data and processes running smoothly.
Who You Are
• You have 5+ years of experience in sales strategy, revenue strategy, management consulting, business strategy or analytics, ideally in digital media, advertising technology or ad-supported platforms.
• You have a working knowledge of how advertising is bought and sold, across direct, programmatic and self-serve channels and both brand and agency relationships.
• You have hands-on experience building account segmentation, coverage or territory models, or running growth programs that drove measurable revenue results.
• You have hands-on experience using AI to solve business problems, such as using LLM tools (for example Claude or ChatGPT) to automate analysis or build internal tools.
• You are highly analytical and comfortable with large datasets. Experience with SQL, BigQuery, Salesforce and BI tools is valuable.
• You turn analysis into clear recommendations and build trust with Sales leaders and cross-functional partners through crisp writing and presentations.
• You are a self-starter who owns your work end to end, manages several projects at once, and thrives in a fast-moving, matrixed environment.
Where You’ll Be
• This role is based in New York, NY
• We ask that you come into the New York office 1-2 times per week.
• We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! There will be some in person meetings, but still allows for flexibility to work from home.
The United States base range for this position is $119,981 - $171,402, plus equity. About Us:
YipitData is the leading market research and analytics firm for the disruptive economy and most recently raised $475M from The Carlyle Group at a valuation of over $1B. Every day, our proprietary technology analyzes billions of alternative data points to uncover actionable insights across sectors like software, AI, cloud, e-commerce, ridesharing, and payments.
Our data and research teams transform raw data into strategic intelligence, delivering accurate, timely, and deeply contextualized analysis that our customers—ranging from the world’s top investment funds to Fortune 500 companies—depend on to drive high-stakes decisions. From sourcing and licensing novel datasets to rigorous analysis and expert narrative framing, our teams ensure clients get not just data, but clarity and confidence.
We operate globally with offices in the US, APAC, and India. Our award-winning, people-centric culture—recognized by Inc. as a Best Workplace for three consecutive years—emphasizes transparency, ownership, and continuous mastery.
What It’s Like to Work at YipitData:
YipitData isn’t a place for coasting—it’s a launchpad for ambitious, impact-driven professionals.
From day one, you’ll take the lead on meaningful work, accelerate your growth, and gain exposure that shapes careers.
Why Top Talent Chooses YipitData:
• Ownership That Matters : You’ll lead high-impact projects with real business outcomes
• Rapid Growth : We compress years of learning into months
• Merit Over Titles : Trust and responsibility are earned through execution, not tenure
• Velocity with Purpose: We move fast, support each other, and aim high—always with purpose and intention
If your ambition is matched by your work ethic—and you're hungry for a place where growth, impact, and ownership are the norm—YipitData might be the opportunity you’ve been waiting for.
About The Role:
The Investor Portal is the front door to YipitData's investor data. It is where investors download reports, engage with dashboards, and experience the data we collect and the research we publish. For many of our clients it is the first and most frequent contact they have with YipitData, and it shapes how they judge the quality of everything behind it. Our goal is for YipitData to be the default intelligence platform for anyone analyzing companies and markets, and the portal is where we win client mindshare: it should be a place investors open every day, not only when a report lands.
We are looking for a Group Product Manager to own the whole investor portal experience: its strategy, its product team, and its results. You will set the vision for how investors find, read, explore, and act on our data, and you will build a team with the design sense, technical depth, and customer insight to deliver it. Deep, continuous customer discovery is the most important part of this job: you will build the understanding of how investors work, and what would make the portal part of their daily routine, that should shape every roadmap decision. We want an AI-native leader who sees that search, discovery, and personalization will define how investors work with data over the next several years, and who wants to build that experience at YipitData.
This is a player-coach role. You will manage and develop a team of product managers while staying hands-on with the most important problems in the portal. You should be comfortable moving between portfolio decisions, coaching PMs, reviewing designs pixel by pixel, and working through the details of a product yourself.
This is a remote-friendly opportunity that can sit in NYC (where our headquarters is located), one of our office hubs, or anywhere else in the US. However, depending upon where the remote work is performed, income could be subject to New York State tax withholding.
As Our Group Product Manager, Investor Experience You Will:
•
Own the Investor Portal Vision and Strategy
• Set the end-to-end vision for the portal across reports, dashboards, and data, with a roadmap tied to engagement, retention, time to insight, and commercial results.
• Make the portal a daily destination and the front door to YipitData as the default intelligence platform for anyone analyzing companies and markets.
• Tell one coherent story across reports, dashboards, key metrics, and data feeds, so investors move between research, metrics, and data without needing to know how our products are organized.
Lead Deep Customer Discovery
• Run continuous discovery with fundamental and quantitative investors: interviews, observation, and workflow walkthroughs of how they prepare, monitor, and decide.
• Combine that with usage, search, and client feedback to find where the portal helps and where it gets in the way, and turn it into clear product bets.
• Share what you learn widely, and set the discovery standard for your PMs.
Lead and Develop the Product Team
• Coach and grow a team of PMs, with clear ownership, goals, and decision rights.
• Build strong practices for planning, design critique, experimentation, and measurement, and hire to a high bar.
Raise the Bar on Design and Product Craft
• Own the quality of the investor experience, from information architecture to visual polish, in partnership with Design and a shared design system.
• Make complex financial and alternative data easy to understand and trust.
Build AI-Native Experiences
• Shape how AI changes the portal: natural language access, summarization, and question answering over our research and data.
• Decide what to build, adopt, or leave out, and define evaluation and guardrails for accuracy and attribution.
• Use AI in your own workflow and set the example for your team.
Own Search, Discovery, and Personalization
• Own search so investors can find the right report, dashboard, company, or metric quickly.
• Build discovery and personalization around each investor's coverage, watchlists, and behavior, working with Data Science and Engineering on ranking and relevance.
Drive Results Across Teams
• Share accountability with Revenue, Client Strategy, and Product Marketing for adoption, retention, and expansion, and instrument the portal with the metrics that matter.
• Align Product, Design, Engineering, Data, Research, and commercial teams, and communicate strategy, risks, and tradeoffs clearly.
Close the Loop with Research and Data
• Bring portal usage back to Research and Data: what investors open, search for, download, and fail to find, with recommendations on coverage, formats, and new metrics on a set cadence.
• Make sure new reports, feeds, datasets, and metrics reach the portal in a form investors can use.
You Are Likely To Succeed If:

About this role
Business Overview
BlackRock’s Risk & Quantitative Analysis (RQA) group provides independent oversight of BlackRock’s fiduciary and enterprise risks. RQA’s mission is to advance the firm’s risk management practices and to deliver independent risk expertise and constructive challenge to drive better business and investment outcomes. RQA’s risk managers play a meaningful role in BlackRock’s investment process, using quantitative analysis and a multi-disciplinary skillset to tackle real-world problems and provide tangible solutions in the investment management process.
RQA is committed to investing in our people to increase both individual enablement and a strong collaborative environment. As a global group located all around the world, our goal is to create a culture of inclusion which encourages teamwork, innovation, diversity, and the development our future leaders. We actively engage in discussions on career growth and work with team members to understand how personal passions and strengths connect with our purpose.
Fixed Income Investment Risk Management
You will be a risk manager as part of RQA fixed income investment risk, which oversees BlackRock’s $1trillion active fixed income investment platform including Multi-sector fixed income, Credit, Securitized, Financial Institutions and Muni business. You will work with other fixed income investment risk managers to deliver independent risk oversight, risk advice, and provide quantitative analysis to assist with portfolio construction, product design and investor engagement.
Key Responsibilities:
The RQA fixed income risk team is seeking a candidate with fixed income risk management experience to support the risk management efforts of our US active fixed income investment platform. Responsibilities include both day-to-day risk management and contribution to strategic projects to enhance risk and portfolio management processes.
• Work with senior risk managers to provide risk oversight and risk management support to fixed income investment teams.
• Provide independent, constructive challenge of portfolio risk taking, exposure, portfolio construction and performance analysis.
• Provide day-to-day risk management to portfolio managers. Conduct regular risk meetings with analyses and deep dives on risk and performance to portfolio management teams.
• Perform quantitative analysis to help investors understand risk analytics, risk models, performance attribution and help improve investment process.
• Partner with BlackRock Aladdin risk modeling team to deliver state-of-the-practice risk analytics and credit risk models through the Aladdin platform.
• Collaborate with peers in RQA investment risk and enterprise risk, help mentor junior team members.
Qualifications:
• Degree in quantitative field such as mathematics, finance, economics, statistics, computer science, or engineering
• Approximately 3 years of relevant experience in investment risk management, quantitative analysis or a related field
• A passion for applying quantitative techniques to real-world investment problems, including portfolio risk analysis and understanding financial markets
• Excellent interpersonal, leadership and oral/written communication skills. Ability to communicate, influence and engage with portfolio managers on risk discussions.
• Strong technical skills and programming skills in Python, familiarity with BlackRock’s Aladdin risk system is a strong plus.
• A strong work ethic and ability to work effectively in a team environment and adhere to tight deadlines.
• Familiarity with fixed-income investment concepts and buy-side risk management is a plus but not required — candidates with strong quantitative skills from adjacent fields are encouraged to apply

For New York, NY Only the salary range for this position is USD$116,000.00 - USD$155,000.00 . Additionally, employees are eligible for an annual discretionary bonus, and benefits including healthcare, leave benefits, and retirement benefits. BlackRock operates a pay-for-performance compensation philosophy and your total compensation may vary based on role, location, and firm, department and individual performance.

Our benefits
To help you stay energized, engaged and inspired, we offer a wide range of benefits including a strong retirement plan, tuition reimbursement, comprehensive healthcare, support for working parents and Flexible Time Off (FTO) so you can relax, recharge and be there for the people you care about.
Our hybrid work model
BlackRock’s hybrid work model is designed to enable a culture of collaboration and apprenticeship that enriches the experience of our employees, while supporting flexibility for all. Employees are currently required to work at least 4 days in the office per week, with the flexibility to work from home 1 day a week. Some business groups may require more time in the office due to their roles and responsibilities. We remain focused on increasing the impactful moments that arise when we work together in person – aligned with our commitment to performance and innovation. As a new joiner, you can count on this hybrid model to accelerate your learning and onboarding experience here at BlackRock.
Guidance on AI use for candidates
At BlackRock, AI has long been part of how we work – enhancing decision-making, improving operations, and helping us deliver better outcomes for clients. We encourage candidates to use AI thoughtfully to learn, prepare, and work more effectively; but during our interview process, we want to focus on getting to know you through your own experiences, thinking, and judgment. To support you, we’ve provided guidance on when and how to use AI during our hiring process so you can approach each step with confidence and showcase your best self.
About BlackRock
At BlackRock, we are all connected by one mission: to help more and more people experience financial well-being. Our clients, and the people they serve, are saving for retirement, paying for their children’s educations, buying homes and starting businesses. Their investments also help to strengthen the global economy: support businesses small and large; finance infrastructure projects that connect and power cities; and facilitate innovations that drive progress.
This mission would not be possible without our smartest investment – the one we make in our employees. It’s why we’re dedicated to creating an environment where our colleagues feel welcomed, valued and supported with networks, benefits and development opportunities to help them thrive.

Senior Manager, Product Manager - Fraud Decisioning
At Capital One, we believe great products begin with a deep understanding of our customers. From our earliest days, we pioneered the use of predictive modeling to individually personalize credit card offers, turning the entire industry on its head. As we’ve grown bigger, we’ve found more and more ways to use technology and face-to-face conversations to understand the human problems associated with money and finances.
In the Consumer Bank, we’ve combined this human-centered approach with our heritage of data-driven decision making to design, build and test our way to truly enabling financial experiences. We’ve challenged ourselves to spend less time planning, more time doing, and, above all else, to see the world through the eyes of our customers as they work to understand and manage their money.
Are you passionate about improving the way people interact with their money? Are you driven by the delight you bring to customers? Do you keep asking, “why,” until you hit the root? It’s common to fall in love with solutions, but have you ever fallen in love with the problem? Do you have an opinion on whether shipping is more important than perfection? Do you have a healthy dose of skepticism for the impossible? If you’re nodding your head, then we want you!
About the Team
At the heart of any bank account, customers move and manage their money—transferring money between their accounts, wiring money to purchase a home, and more. At the same time, bad actors are constantly evolving to scam or steal from our customers. Our mission is twofold: make it seamless for good customers to use their account day in, day out, while making it impossible for those bad actors to get in.
To accomplish this, we build the intelligent data-driven brain behind those customer experiences, managing the policies, models, and data integrations that power our automated decisions. We also design empathetic, trust-building experiences for customers and associates when a decision requires a human touch. We are a team of strategists, builders, and customer advocates who thrive on solving complex problems at the intersection of technology, data, and human experience.
Role Overview
As a people leader, you will lead a high-performing team of product managers focused on protecting customers and the bank from fraud across key payment experiences. We are looking for a highly-strategic thought leader and someone who excels at building partnerships across teams and domains. You will lead and guide your team to partner closely across engineering, business analytics, data science, and cross-functional teams to build intelligent decisioning frameworks and empathetic end-to-end customer journeys, shaping and executing our multi-year fraud strategy.
On any given day in the Bank you’ll be:
• Empowered. Part of a team driving the bank’s omni-channel acquisitions strategy responsible for setting and delivering the decisioning and treatment framework to ensure our business is gaining profitable customers through both digital and digital-human interactions
• Learning constantly. Work deeply with customers, frontline associates, designers, technologists, analysts, marketers and data scientists to build cutting edge solutions
• Innovating relentlessly. Pushing big change by asking bold questions; starting small, testing, and learning your way to something dramatically better
• Sharing openly. Telling stories that change the way people think about building products and solving problems, and that illustrate the power of what software can do to make them even better
• Connecting creatively. Jump-starting a self-supporting community by sowing the right seeds, building the right tools, integrating the right off-the-shelf products, and just plain elbow grease
• Succeeding strategically. Solving the right problem and holding on the wrong one.
Capital One Product Framework
In this role, you’ll be expected to demonstrate proficiency in five key areas which we consider to be the foundation for successful Product Management:
• Human Centered - Obsesses about internal and external customer needs to reimagine and innovate product solutions
• Business Focused - Delivers game-changing outcomes by focusing on leverage and execution excellence
• Technology Driven - Leverages technology to deliver innovative and resilient solutions that enable both near term and long term value
• Integrated Problem Solving - Identifies and resolves complex problems to deliver outcomes while mitigating product risks
• Transformational Leadership - Leads cross functional teams to solve customer problems and drive organizational alignment
Basic Qualifications:
• Currently has, or is in the process of obtaining one of the following with an expectation that the required degree will be obtained on or before the scheduled start date:
• A Bachelor's or Master’s Degree in a quantitative field (Statistics, Economics, Operations Research, Analytics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Software Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Information Systems or a related quantitative field), Business or Marketing
OR
• Bachelor's degree in any field and at least 4 years of Product Management experience
Preferred Qualifications:
• Experience translating business strategy and analysis into consumer facing digital products

AML Investigator II - List Screening Operations
Summary:
List Screening Operations (LSO) performs screening, research, and disposition work for Capital One's Economic Sanctions Compliance Program related to the Office of Foreign Asset Control (OFAC). The program is established as a matter of sound banking practice and ensures compliance with federally-mandated economic sanctions against dangerous or criminal individuals, organizations, and governments who should be denied access to financial services. In addition, LSO performs screening research, and disposition against various lists (i.g. Financial Crime Enforcement Network (FinCEN), Negative News, Politically Exposed Person (PEP), etc.). LSO also supports various Anti-Money Laundering (AML) processes, which might include suspicious activity investigations, Currency Transaction Report (CTR) report monitoring, customer due diligence, and enhanced due diligence or other processes.
Responsibilities:
- Manage list screening case work in a timely and efficient manner. Execute a variety of tasks in support of the conduct of investigations
- Analyze and investigate individuals who potentially match entities on various watch lists utilizing Anti-Money Laundering typologies
- Summarize, in writing, the result of investigations conducted
- Escalate cases and issues as appropriate for advanced investigation and analysis
- Build and maintain awareness of the broader context and implications of the various types of sanctions risks affecting the business (e.g., financial, legal, reputation, etc.)
- Assess and handle sensitive data and investigations with professional demeanor
Basic Qualifications:
• High School Diploma, GED or Equivalent Certification
• At least 1 year of Microsoft Office experience, or at least 1 year of Google Suite experience.
Preferred Qualifications:
• Bachelor's Degree in Criminal Justice, Fraud Prevention, Homeland Security, Finance, or Military experience
• Certified Anti-Money Laundering Specialist Certification (CAMS)
• At least 1 year of experience in fraud detection, or at least 1 year of investigative techniques experience used in the investigation of financial crimes
• At least 1 year of experience in the Banking industry

Business Manager, AI Underwriting Strategy
Summary:
Capital One's Commercial Bank is reinventing how it underwrites loans with agentic AI. Commercial lending is exactly the kind of complex, document-heavy, judgment-driven work where AI agents can change how the job gets done: today, a single deal can move through 100+ steps and touch as many as 45 people. The newly formed Commercial AI Underwriting Platform team is building an AI-native underwriting platform from the ground up. The platform's aim is to augment our underwriters' and credit officers' capabilities by running the end-to-end underwriting workflow, while leaving them free to shape deal terms, credit policy and override the system when necessary.
Role Description & What You'd Be Doing:
We are seeking a Business Manager, AI Underwriting Strategy to serve as the strategy lead for the platform. You will shape where and how AI changes underwriting and portfolio management across the Commercial Bank, and carry that strategy to senior audiences across Commercial and the Enterprise. This is a white-space role with significant executive visibility. You'll help define what an AI-native commercial bank looks like, build the case for it, and align the Underwriting, Risk, Product, and Tech leaders needed to make it real.
Key Competencies:
• Executive-Ready Communicator: Drafts crisp, executive-ready memos and presentations that turn complex technical work and white-space opportunities into a clear storyline and recommendation.

The Company
PayPal has been revolutionizing commerce globally for more than 25 years. Creating innovative experiences that make moving money, selling, and shopping simple, personalized, and secure, PayPal empowers consumers and businesses in approximately 200 markets to join and thrive in the global economy.
We operate a global, two-sided network at scale that connects hundreds of millions of merchants and consumers. We help merchants and consumers connect, transact, and complete payments, whether they are online or in person. PayPal is more than a connection to third-party payment networks. We provide proprietary payment solutions accepted by merchants that enable the completion of payments on our platform on behalf of our customers.
We offer our customers the flexibility to use their accounts to purchase and receive payments for goods and services, as well as the ability to transfer and withdraw funds. We enable consumers to exchange funds more safely with merchants using a variety of funding sources, which may include a bank account, a PayPal or Venmo account balance, PayPal and Venmo branded credit products, a credit card, a debit card, certain cryptocurrencies, or other stored value products such as gift cards, and eligible credit card rewards. Our PayPal, Venmo, and Xoom products also make it safer and simpler for friends and family to transfer funds to each other. We offer merchants an end-to-end payments solution that provides authorization and settlement capabilities, as well as instant access to funds and payouts. We also help merchants connect with their customers, process exchanges and returns, and manage risk. We enable consumers to engage in cross-border shopping and merchants to extend their global reach while reducing the complexity and friction involved in enabling cross-border trade.
Our beliefs are the foundation for how we conduct business every day. We live each day guided by our core values of Inclusion, Innovation, Collaboration, and Wellness. Together, our values ensure that we work together as one global team with our customers at the center of everything we do – and they push us to ensure we take care of ourselves, each other, and our communities.

users and the business.

Essential Responsibilities:
• Uses data to build insights on product or platform requirements consistent with the shared vision for the product.
• Gathers insights from the customer experience and customer needs to input to product requirements
• Analyzes research, market analysis and usability studies, research and market analysis to support data-driven decision making
• Monitors product profitability measures, including budget.
• Lead sprint planning, daily standups and retrospectives to drive execution. Interfaces with product and technology leadership as needed.
• Partners with content developers, data scientists, product designers and user experience researchers to identify new opportunities.

What You Will Do
• Use data to build insights on product and platform requirements that fit the shared vision for the Payouts product portfolio.
• Gather insights from the payee and payer experience, including onboarding, payout method selection, delivery speed, fees, and support needs, and turn them into clear product requirements.
• Analyze research, market analysis, and usability studies to support data-driven decisions on features such as payout rails, currencies, and disbursement controls.
• Monitor product profitability, including budget, unit economics, and cost drivers such as processing and network fees.
• Lead sprint planning, daily standups, and retrospectives to drive execution, and interface with product and technology leadership as needed.
• Partner with content developers, data scientists, product designers, and user experience researchers to identify new opportunities.
• Work with risk, compliance, legal, and finance partners so that payout products meet regulatory, fraud, and reporting expectations across markets.

• 5+ years of relevant experience and a bachelor's degree, or any equivalent combination of education and experience.
• You anticipate needs, follow through on commitments, and rally others to move work forward without waiting to be asked.
• You deliver value through agile, iterative methods and make smart trade-offs while holding a high bar under pressure.
• You form hypotheses, run lightweight experiments or prototypes, and use the results to discover, de-risk, and evolve product direction.
• You build trusted relationships and influence decisions through clarity, context, and collaboration.
• You break down ambiguous problems with structured thinking and data to find root causes and evaluate options.
• You understand technical systems well enough to communicate clearly with engineers and make credible trade-offs.
• You understand core AI and ML concepts and responsible practices and can apply them to AI-powered products.
Nice to Have
• Experience with payments, money movement, or disbursement products, such as bank transfers, wallets, cards, or cross-border payouts.
• Familiarity with payments APIs, developer platforms, or marketplace and platform business models.
• Working knowledge of fraud, KYC, AML, or sanctions requirements that affect payouts.
• Experience using experimentation and analytics tools to guide product decisions.
• Interest in applying AI to improve pay

Job Summary:
Venmo is hiring a Lead Product Manager to build and launch its first lending product, spanning open-ended borrowing and personal loans. As the founding product owner for Venmo Lending, you will take the product from 0 to 1, shaping the strategy, evaluating build, buy, and partner options, and leading discovery, pilot, launch, and scale. You will partner across Engineering, Design, Risk, Finance, Compliance, Legal, Marketing, and external lending partners to create a responsible, profitable lending experience that gives Venmo customers a trusted way to borrow. Success requires balancing customer experience with credit performance, regulatory requirements, and sustainable unit economics.
Job Description:
Essential Responsibilities:
• Inputs to product strategy with cross-functional stakeholders consistent with the shared vision for the product or enabling platform.
• Implements the architectural roadmap that balances innovative design and technical implementation, while balancing regulatory requirements, time-to-market, meeting customer needs and product profitability.
• Controls for the customer experience and customer needs in product requirements and as an input to decision making.
• Monitors metrics that inform the success of products including usability studies, research and market analysis.
• Manages one or more workstreams to include analytics, customer discovery, market research and competitive analysis to drive data-driven decision-making.
• Monitors product profitability measures, including budget.
• Participates in operational mechanisms that drive execution and accountability including Product Reviews, Operating Reviews, and Business Reviews. Interfaces with product and technology leadership as needed.
• Partners with content developers, data scientists, product designers and user experience researchers.
Minimum Qualifications:
• 5+ years relevant experience and a Bachelor’s degree OR Any equivalent combination of education and experience.
Additional Responsibilities & Preferred Qualifications :
Additional Responsibilities
• Define the strategy and product constructs for Venmo Lending, including open-ended borrowing and personal loans, and lead the product from discovery through pilot, launch, and scale.
• Develop the business case, target customer strategy, product sequencing, investment requirements, and success criteria for a new lending business.
• Evaluate build, buy, and partner opportunities, including originating bank, servicing, funding, and other external lending partnerships.
• Define key lending experiences and product parameters across eligibility, underwriting, pricing, limits, repayment, servicing, collections, and hardship.
• Partner with Risk and Finance to establish credit policy, approval and loss targets, pricing, and unit economics that balance responsible growth and profitability.
• Establish and monitor lending-specific KPIs, including approval, take rate, utilization, repayment, delinquency, losses, acquisition cost, and contribution margin.
• Partner with Compliance and Legal to incorporate consumer lending, fair lending, disclosure, adverse-action, bank-partner, and audit requirements into the product roadmap.
• Lead staged launches and experimentation, using customer, credit, and financial performance to inform scaling decisions.
• Partner with Growth and Marketing to develop acquisition, cross-sell, and responsible lending strategies across the Venmo ecosystem.
Preferred Qualifications
• 7+ years of product management experience, including owning a consumer lending or credit product (such as personal loans, lines of credit, credit cards, or BNPL) in a fintech or bank.
• Experience owning a consumer lending or credit product, such as personal loans, revolving lines of credit, credit cards, or BNPL, within a fintech or financial institution.
• Demonstrated experience taking a new financial product from 0 to 1 and through launch and scale.
• Working knowledge of the credit lifecycle, including underwriting, pricing, servicing, collections, and credit loss management.
• Experience operating in a regulated consumer lending environment and partnering closely with Risk, Compliance, and Legal.
• Strong understanding of lending unit economics, P&L drivers, credit and funnel metrics, and financial forecasting.
• Experience using SQL, dashboards, experimentation, and credit performance data to drive product decisions.
• Experience with bank partnerships, loan sales, forward-flow arrangements, or capital markets and funding structures.
• Experience with credit decisioning, underwriting models, alternative data, and data science partnerships.

Make your mark at one of the biggest names in payments. We’re looking for a Lead, Transformation and Corporate Strategy to join our ever evolving team and help shape the future of global commerce.
The Global Payments' Transformation Office is a central, enterprise-wide function based in the company's Atlanta headquarters (Buckhead) that partners closely with executive leadership to drive integration, growth, operating model, and cost transformation across the firm. The Transformation Office works across business units and functions to translate strategic priorities into executable transformation programs, establish enterprise transformation frameworks and operating cadence, and ensure disciplined value realization. The team partners with business unit, regional, and functional leadership to design scalable operating models, enable successful integration and separation, and drive sustainable growth and cost efficiency.
What You Will Own
The Lead, Transformation and Corporate Strategy is a core problem solver within the Transformation Office, supporting the leader heading Corporate Strategy in Transformation Office and other senior transformation leaders on enterprise strategy, operating model, and transformation initiatives.
Transformation Office responsible for framing and solving the enterprise's hardest structural questions: where the operating model should change, how the organization should be designed to deliver it, and what it takes to make the change stick.
The role suits someone at the Senior Analyst or Associate level at a top-tier consulting firm who wants ownership of a problem rather than a slice of one. The Lead structures ambiguous questions, designs and runs the analysis, builds the fact base, and drafts the storyline that goes to senior leadership, then stays with the recommendation through execution.
• Structured problem solving: Break complex business questions into issue trees and testable hypotheses, identify the analyses that will resolve them, and drive toward a fact-based answer.
• Analysis and modeling: Build the quantitative fact base, including cost baselines, business cases, sizing models, and scenario analysis of alternative structures and operating configurations.
• Benchmarking and research : Run market, competitor, customer, organizational, cost, and process benchmarking, and use external evidence to calibrate internal ambition.
• Operating model analysis : Assess organization structures, spans and layers, decision rights, processes, capabilities, and service delivery models, and evaluate the implications of design alternatives.
• Storylining and executive materials: Draft pyramid-structured presentations and decision documents for senior leadership, steering committees, and governance forums.
• Transformation execution: Support workstreams across organizational redesign, cost transformation, growth initiatives, integrations, and separations, including planning, tracking, and issue resolution.
• Performance and value tracking: Help build baselines, KPIs, milestones, and tracking mechanisms that monitor outcomes and enable value realization.
• Cross-functional collaboration: Work with Finance, Corporate Development, Technology, Operations, HR, Risk, Legal, and Commercial teams to gather data, validate assumptions, and build recommendations.
• Tools and methodology: Develop analytical tools, templates, dashboards, and methodologies that improve how the Transformation Office diagnoses and executes strategic initiatives.
What You Will Bring
• 2-5 years of experience in management consulting, corporate strategy, or enterprise transformation, including significant time at a top-tier strategy or transformation consulting firm at the Associate or Senior Analyst level .
• Bachelor's degree in Business, Economics, Strategy, Engineering, or a related field required; MBA or other advanced degree preferred.
• Experience in payments, fintech, technology-enabled services, or complex global operations is advantageous.

Come join the Pricing and Valuations team in Fidelity Fund and Investment Operations (FFIO). Reporting to the Senior Pricing Manager, the Senior Pricing Representative plays a critical role in ensuring the accuracy, integrity, and timeliness of security valuations used to calculate Net Asset Values (NAVs) for Fidelity mutual funds and other investment products. This position is responsible for performing daily pricing oversight, researching valuation exceptions, assessing risk, and partnering with internal and external stakeholders to support accurate shareholder reporting and regulatory compliance. Success in this role requires balancing multiple priorities, identifying potential valuation risks, and collaborating effectively across teams to resolve complex pricing issues.
Key Responsibilities
• Perform daily valuation oversight and pricing validation for a broad range of securities, including equities, fixed income instruments, derivatives, private markets, and other complex investment products.
• Analyze price movements, valuation exceptions, and market events to determine appropriate pricing outcomes and escalate risks when necessary.
• Support the daily calculation and release of fund NAVs by ensuring pricing information is accurate, complete, and timely.
• Investigate pricing discrepancies through research, data analysis, and collaboration with internal business partners, pricing vendors, and custodians.
• Assess operational, financial, and reputational risks associated with security valuations and proactively identify solutions to mitigate potential impacts.
• Maintain a strong control environment by adhering to established policies, procedures, and regulatory requirements.
• Utilize critical thinking and sound judgment to resolve pricing issues that may not have clear or established solutions.
• Partner with colleagues across Operations, Asset Management, Technology, Risk, Compliance, and Fund Accounting to support business objectives and issue resolution.
• Contribute to process improvement initiatives designed to enhance operational efficiency, reduce risk, and improve scalability.
• Support testing and implementation of system enhancements, automation efforts, and operational change initiatives.
• Communicate findings, recommendations, and risk considerations clearly and effectively to stakeholders at varying levels of the organization.
The Expertise and Skills You Bring
• Bachelor's degree or equivalent work experience.
• 1+ years of experience in financial services, operations, accounting, finance, investments, or related fields.
• Strong analytical, organizational, and communication skills.
• Demonstrated ability to work effectively in a deadline-driven environment.
• Strong organizational and time management skills with the ability to meet multiple daily deadlines.
• Excellent analytical and problem-solving capabilities.
• Ability to identify, assess, and escalate high-risk situations appropriately.
• Strong attention to detail and commitment to accuracy.
• Ability to manage competing priorities in a dynamic environment.
• Demonstrated research and investigative skills.
• Strong written and verbal communication skills.
• Collaborative mindset with the ability to build effective working relationships across teams.
• Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, particularly Excel.
• Strong technical proficiency required, including advanced knowledge of Microsoft Office applications, particularly Excel. Candidates should be comfortable working with complex formulas and data analysis tools. The successful candidate will also demonstrate the ability to quickly learn, adapt to, and effectively utilize new systems, applications, and operating platforms.
• Ability to learn and navigate multiple systems and applications effectively
• Understanding of NAV calculations, security valuation methodologies, and investment operations processes is a plus.
• Knowledge of pricing, mutual funds, equities, fixed income, and derivatives preferred
• Ability to recognize high-risk items and escalate those items or seek assistance to minimize loss to either the shareholder or Fidelity.
• Flexibility to work extended hours as needed to support daily valuation activities, NAV production deadlines, market events, and other critical business priorities.

• Manage requests involving trade corrections and reversals, financial adjustments, restricted-asset attribute changes, and other specialized trade activity.
• Work across DTC, Fed, non-depository (NDS), and global trade activity.
• Manage daily production while responding to time-sensitive requests and established trade and settlement deadlines.
• Partner with Trade Services, Settlements, other Custody Operations teams, Corporate Trust Operations, and other business lines to research and resolve issues.
• Learn and utilize multiple systems and applications, including the team's Issue Tracker workflow.
• Help strengthen operational processes, procedures, and controls while identifying efficiencies, reducing aging exceptions, and mitigating operational risk.
• Develop knowledge across multiple processes through the team's cross-training approach.
What You Can Expect
This is a fast-paced, deadline-driven operational environment where work volume can fluctuate throughout the day, particularly as trade and settlement cutoffs approach. The team is working toward same-day turnaround and, for many basic requests, potentially 2–4 hour turnaround times.
After training, team members are expected to work independently while maintaining strong partnerships across multiple teams and business lines. Rather than operating within strict knowledge silos, the team cross-trains employees so they can build experience across different types of work.

• Three years or more of related experience.

• Bachelor’s degree.

• Ability to work independently and manage responsibilities with minimal supervision.
• Ability to multitask, balance competing priorities, and meet established deadlines in a dynamic environment.
• Strong interpersonal and customer relationship skills.
• Strong verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across teams.
• Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications, with intermediate Excel skills preferred.
• Experience with SWP and Courts is beneficial.
• Familiarity with Issue Tracker is helpful but can be learned.
• SQL experience is a plus but is not required.
• Understanding of regulatory and accounting principles that directly affect Wealth Management & Investment Services business lines and clients.
Why This Opportunity
This position offers the opportunity to build broader expertise within Custody Operations while working on increasingly complex trade activity. The role is being added in preparation for the next SWP migration planned for 2027, with particular emphasis on supporting global activity.
The strongest fit will be someone who enjoys researching and solving complex operational problems, working independently, managing time-sensitive priorities, and partnering across teams to move issues through resolution.

Job Description
The Senior Solutions Consultant serves as a key partner to sales teams by supporting the sale, design, and implementation of complex products, services, and integrated solutions. This role combines deep technical expertise with consultative selling skills to help customers understand how solutions align with and enhance their business operations.
The individual will bring a comprehensive understanding of the organization’s products, services, and technical capabilities while positioning bundled and solution-oriented offerings that address customer needs. Acting as a trusted advisor, the role builds customer confidence, resolves technical concerns, and guides prospects through all technical aspects of the sales cycle.
This is a highly visible opportunity for an individual who wants to make a meaningful impact. While the role sits within a large financial institution, the organization operates with the speed, urgency, and innovation of a technology company . The successful candidate will work across multiple lines of business, products, industries, and customer segments and will have significant exposure to senior executives and key leaders across the organization. In many cases, this individual will be viewed as a subject-matter expert and representative of best-in-class capabilities within the bank .
Key Responsibilities
• Partner with sales teams to identify, develop, and close opportunities involving complex products, services, and integrated solutions.
• Serve as the primary technical resource throughout the sales process, articulating the value and functionality of solutions to both technical and non-technical audiences.
• Conduct customer discovery sessions, pre-sales consultations, and technical discussions with prospective and existing clients.
• Design, develop, and deliver customized client proposals, demonstrations, presentations, and solution recommendations.
• Translate complex technical concepts into clear business value and practical solutions for customers.
• Address technical objections, questions, and concerns throughout the sales and implementation lifecycle.
• Consult with clients on solution architecture, integrations, strategies, and best practices to support their business objectives.
• Collaborate with cross-functional teams to assemble comprehensive customer solutions and ensure successful implementation.
• Support proposal development, pricing strategies, and business-case creation.
• Provide implementation guidance and post-sale support to facilitate successful client onboarding and adoption.
• Deliver product education and technical training to sales teams and business partners.
• Maintain current knowledge of products, technologies, industry trends, competitive offerings, and emerging capabilities.
• Help identify opportunities to improve existing solutions and develop new approaches to address evolving customer needs.
• Build strong relationships with customers, sales teams, product leaders, technology teams, and senior executives.
Why This Role Is Different
This is not a traditional technical sales role within a large financial institution. The team operates with a high degree of speed, flexibility, and ownership, providing an environment where individuals can have a direct influence on how the business evolves.
The successful candidate will have the opportunity to work on important strategic initiatives, solve complex customer challenges, and help shape solutions rather than simply execute an established playbook. The role provides exposure to senior executives and leaders across the organization and the ability to work across a broad range of businesses and capabilities.
For someone coming from a fintech, payments company, technology organization, or another financial institution, this role provides an opportunity to bring that experience into an organization with the scale, resources, stability, and reach of a major bank —while retaining the ability to move quickly and make an impact.
The Ideal Candidate
We are looking for someone with energy, curiosity, initiative, and a genuine desire to make an impact . The ideal candidate is a builder and problem solver who enjoys figuring out how to make things work. They are comfortable with ambiguity, willing to challenge conventional thinking, and motivated to turn ideas into action. They take ownership, build strong relationships, and are willing to do the work necessary to deliver results.
The candidate may come from a fintech, payments company, technology organization, or another financial institution and be looking for an opportunity where their experience and ideas can have a broader impact.
Most importantly, this person wants to do meaningful work, have visibility with senior leadership, and help establish what best-in-class looks like within the bank .
Basic Qualifications
• Bachelor’s degree or equivalent combination of education and relevant work experience.
• Typically 10+ years of experience in technical sales, solutions consulting, solution architecture, payments, financial technology, or a related client-facing role.
Preferred Skills/Experience
• Typically 10+ years of experience in technical sales, solutions consulting, solution architecture, payments, financial technology, or a related client-facing role.
• Strong understanding of complex financial products, technology solutions, integrations, and business processes.
• Demonstrated consultative selling and customer-facing experience.
• Proven ability to develop customized customer solutions and articulate their business value.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities.
• Excellent verbal, written, presentation, and customer communication skills.
• Ability to work effectively across multiple functional areas and navigate complex organizations.
• Demonstrated ability to manage multiple priorities and operate effectively in a fast-paced environment.
• Experience in financial services, payments, fintech, banking technology, or related industries.
• Experience working for a fintech, technology company, payments organization, or financial institution.
• Experience selling or supporting complex integrated technology and payment solutions.
• Strong understanding of APIs, integrations, digital platforms, and technology-enabled financial solutions.
• Experience working directly with senior executives and sophisticated enterprise clients.
• Demonstrated history of taking ownership of complex initiatives and driving them to completion.

Job Description
U.S. Bank is seeking a full-time Portfolio Analytics & Strategic Planning Manager to advance portfolio reporting, analytics, strategic planning, and prioritization capabilities. This role will lead the continued development and adoption of Power BI solutions, translate complex data into actionable insights, and deliver clear recommendations to leaders to support informed decision-making. This candidate will also build and maintain strategic roadmaps, support portfolio prioritization activities, and help ensure Jira data and workflows remain accurate, consistent, and decision-ready.
Participates in the identification, design, development and implementation of assigned projects. Assigned projects may be general or systems related in nature. Interfaces with internal and external resources to ensure successful and timely completion in accordance with user needs. Participates in training users and evaluating the project. Manages performance of the project team and evaluates overall team performance.
Key Responsibilities
• Power BI Development: Design, build, enhance, and maintain scalable Power BI dashboards, reports, semantic models, and supporting data solutions that provide timely visibility into portfolio performance, demand, capacity, delivery, financials, risks, and outcomes.
• Analytics and Insights: Analyze portfolio and operational data to identify trends, dependencies, risks, opportunities, and performance gaps; convert findings into concise, actionable insights.
• Leadership Reporting: Prepare and present recurring and ad hoc reporting to leadership, clearly communicating performance, key decisions, tradeoffs, and recommended actions.
• Strategic Recommendations: Develop evidence-based recommendations that improve portfolio outcomes, resource allocation, sequencing, governance, and execution.
• Strategic Roadmaps: Build and maintain integrated strategic roadmaps that connect business objectives, initiatives, milestones, dependencies, expected benefits, and delivery timelines.
• Prioritization Support: Assist with intake, evaluation, scoring, sequencing, and prioritization processes; support leadership discussions with transparent data, scenario analysis, and decision materials.
• Jira Administration, Data Quality, and Usage Standards: Maintain accurate and complete portfolio information in Jira to aid in data flows to Power BI for reporting and analysis.
• Power BI User Training and Enablement: Develop and deliver ongoing user training, guidance, and support to promote accurate and effective use of Power BI and related portfolio tools.
• Process Improvement: Identify opportunities to standardize, automate, and improve reporting, roadmap management, prioritization, and portfolio governance practices.
• Stakeholder Partnership: Collaborate with business, technology, finance, product, and delivery partners to validate data, align reporting needs, and support portfolio decisions.
• Documentation and Controls: Maintain definitions, data standards, reporting procedures, governance documentation, and quality controls to promote reliable and repeatable portfolio management practices.
Basic Qualifications
• -Master's degree, or equivalent work experience
• 10 or more years of experience in project management activities
Preferred Skills/Experience
• Bachelor’s degree in business, analytics, technology, or a related field, or equivalent work experience; 8+ years of experience.
• Demonstrated ability to build, enhance, and maintain Power BI dashboards, reports, data models, calculations, visualizations, and supporting data solutions; advanced expertise in Power Query, DAX, workspace management, security, refresh processes, and performance optimization preferred.
• Hands-on experience building and maintaining Jira and SharePoint solutions, structures, workflows, lists, sites, and reporting capabilities; experience integrating or analyzing data from Jira, SharePoint, Excel, financial systems, and other enterprise sources preferred.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with demonstrated ability to interpret complex data and translate findings into actionable business insights and recommendations; experience with financial analysis, capacity planning, benefits tracking, scenario modeling, or executive scorecards preferred.
• Working knowledge of strategic roadmaps, portfolio prioritization.
• Excellent written and verbal communication and stakeholder-management skills, including experience developing executive-level presentations and communicating with senior leaders and cross-functional stakeholders; ability to influence decisions without direct authority and work effectively across business and technology teams preferred.
• Strong organizational skills and exceptional attention to detail, with demonstrated ability to train and support users, reinforce tool standards, and promote consistent adoption of common processes.

Job Description
We are seeking a Product Marketing Manager to help commercialize and grow our small and medium-sized business (SMB) solutions, with a strong emphasis on retail, and eCommerce. This is a critical hire as we scale our commerce capabilities and bring high-impact product initiatives to market.
This role will partner closely with the go-to-market team and collaborate across Product, Engineering, Sales, Customer Success, Partnerships/Channels, Operations, Support, Finance, and Marketing to ensure successful launches and improvements to existing solutions. Working independently, you will bring clear customer insight, strong judgment, and a high bar for execution to help teams align on what to ship, how to launch it, and how to drive adoption and revenue.
Key Responsibilities
• Segmentation & ICP: Define SMB segments/ICP, priority use cases, and persona needs (e.g., owner, GM, practice manager), including clear jobs-to-be-done
• Positioning & narrative: Own the positioning architecture vs. alternatives/competitors; write and maintain the messaging framework and ensure consistency across channels
• Packaging & pricing: Lead packaging and pricing recommendations; partner with Product and Finance on offer design and monetization
• Launch excellence: Own end-to-end launch plans (tiering, success metrics, readiness); drive post-launch iteration to improve adoption and performance
• Sales & channel enablement: Create repeatable plays, pitch decks, talk tracks, objection handling, and competitive battlecards—optimized for fast SMB sales motions and partner delivery
• Voice of Customer & insights: Run/partner on customer discovery, win/loss, and competitive intelligence; turn insights into roadmap input and GTM actions
• Lifecycle & adoption: Partner on onboarding, in-product messaging, retention, and expansion motions—accounting for SMB churn dynamics and implementation constraints
• Be the subject matter expert: Support business process questions sales presentations and messaging deliverables, and training content planning and delivery
• Cross-functional leadership: Partner closely with Product, Sales, Channel, and Marketing to ensure alignment, execution readiness, and measurable outcomes in a matrixed organization
Required Qualifications
• Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.
• 10+ years of experience in product marketing, product commercialization, or go-to-market roles.
• Proven experience marketing to small and medium-sized business (SMB) buyers (owner/operator personas) and/or multi-location SMB customers.
• Experience leading launches from planning through post-launch improvements, including sales enablement assets and training.
• Comfort using data to make decisions (e.g., market sizing, funnel analysis, cohort/adoption metrics) and set measurable success criteria.
• Strategic and thoughtful communicator with outstanding written and verbal communication skills and a track record of turning complex products into simple, customer-reading messaging
Preferred Qualifications
• BA/MBA in marketing, or other business relatd field
• Strong understanding of the payments space.
• Ability to work independently, manage multiple priorities, and operate well in ambiguity.
• Demonstrated marketing and marketing research skills
• Considerable knowledge of product/program development, pricing, implementation and strategic analysis
• Experience working with partner-led selling (resellers/independent software vendors (ISVs)/referral partners), including building materials partners can use to sell.
• Strong analytical skills (financial and competitive analysis; sizing opportunities; measuring adoption).
• Demonstrated management, leadership and interpersonal skills
• MBA or other advanced degree in marketing or a related business field (preferred, not required).
